facts.fact: The brief says examination data (the 2025 Primary Leaving Examination results from the UNEB portal) was integrated into DHIS2-Ed, which also collates the Termly School Report and other datasets, as used by the Makindye Sabagabo municipal education department.

The brief says the DHIS2-Ed system was linked to the Ministry of Health's electronic Integrated Disease Surveillance Reporting (eIDSR) platform so both ministries see school-based surveillance indicators; no date given, so the published date of 2026-04-23 is used.

systems.system: DHIS2 for Education (DHIS2-Ed) / Termly School Report
systems.owner: HISP Uganda with the Ministry of Education and Sports and the Aga Khan Foundation
